verdict.rationale: Resend is an email API, so versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents endpoints, a changelog of new features, and a published OpenAPI spec, but nothing describes API versioning (e.g., version pinning or dated versions) or a deprecation policy. Feature changelog entries and the OpenAPI file are adjacent and do not evidence this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
